session_summary: Initial session focused on establishing a safe space for the student to discuss barriers related to travel costs and household expenses without judgment. The mentor facilitated an activity to separate known school-related costs from unverified household details.
primary_concern: Travel costs adding to household expenses, leading to missed bus fare and walking instead; uncertainty regarding household budget details and support eligibility.

tracked_details.detail: Agreed between-session task: Student to list specific school costs to inquire about with the support office.
Verification of household budget details and support eligibility.

next_steps: Student to attempt listing specific school costs.
Mentor to verify support eligibility and budget details in subsequent sessions.
uncertainties: Exact dates of missed work are uncertain.
Availability of external support services is unconfirmed.
Whether the student can complete the between-session task without teacher assistance.
conclusion: The initial session was helpful in clarifying the main barrier (travel costs/uncertainty) and establishing a cautious plan. No external service was delivered; only an inquiry was planned. The student's reported difficulty remains unresolved pending verification of support eligibility and completion of the between-session task.
